item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine and Russia are exchanging intensified strikes as Ukraine hits a St Petersburg plant that produces missile fuel and a Russian refinery in Saratov, while Russia conducts missile and drone attacks on Ukrainian power facilities and the Northern Bridge. Both sides have also targeted energy infrastructure in other regions, with Russian strikes damaging the Ukrainian power grid and Ukrainian attacks damaging Russia’s second-largest refinery, prompting Rosneft to cap sales. Russia has begun rationing petrol after the Ukrainian refinery attacks, and a Russian FPV drone wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast amid widespread outages. The United Nations Security Council is monitoring the situation as peace talks are set to begin in Abu Dhabi, and the UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024.

A sand embankment collapsed in Gaza, killing a woman and injuring several people. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
